title: Size Uplift by Refund Credit Posted — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts

The size uplift of the late-posting goodwill follows the refund credit posted on the account's credit ledger for the refunded charge's order number: $100.00 or more adds $5.00, $10.00 or more but less than $100.00 adds $2.00, and less than $10.00 adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-posting goodwill figure.

| Refund credit posted for the order number | Uplift |
|---|---|
| $100.00 or more | $5.00 |
| $10.00 to $99.99 | $2.00 |
| under $10.00 | nothing |

At exactly $100.00 the uplift is $5.00; at exactly $10.00 it is $2.00.
